# Tableau

Tableau is a visual analytics platform transforming the way we use data to solve problems

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/tableau/.

## Actions

- **Get Current Session** (read-only): Return the Tableau site and user identity established by the connected PAT, including their LUIDs and the user's current site role.
- **Get Server Info** (read-only): Return the connected Tableau deployment's product, build, and supported REST API versions.
- **Get Workbook** (read-only): Return one Tableau workbook by LUID, including its project, owner, tags, views, and freshness settings when available.
- **List Data Sources** (read-only): List published data sources visible to the connected PAT on its signed-in Tableau site, with optional filtering and sorting, one page at a…
- **List Groups** (read-only): List groups the connected PAT is permitted to see on its signed-in Tableau site, with optional filtering and sorting, one page at a time.
- **List Jobs** (read-only): List active asynchronous jobs the connected PAT is permitted to see on its signed-in Tableau site, optionally narrowed with a Tableau…
- **List Projects** (read-only): List projects visible to the connected PAT on its signed-in Tableau site, with optional filtering and sorting, one page at a time.
- **List Users** (read-only): List users the connected PAT is permitted to see on its signed-in Tableau site, with optional filtering and sorting, one page at a time.
- **List Views** (read-only): List views visible to the connected PAT on its signed-in Tableau site, with optional filtering, sorting, and usage statistics, one page at…
- **List Workbooks** (read-only): List workbooks visible to the connected PAT on its signed-in Tableau site, with optional filtering and sorting, one page at a time.
